address: Plazza dal Mulin 4, Saint Moritz, 7500, Switzerland
bio: This restaurant in the heart of St Moritz makes diners feel very much at home with its wonderfully stylish and modern take on rustic decor and its charming and attentive front-of-house team. As for the food, it is pleasingly uncomplicated, yet carefully considered and subtle. The wine selection is outstanding – and they even have their own wine shop....
